name: mobilecannon-tow
description: D-116: the Asksvin Harness goes on a saddled tame Asksvin only (refused without a saddle), E on the cannon's tow ring hitches it, the harness model shows, the following Asksvin tows the cannon at its own speed (above the 3.5 m/s hand limit), E again unhitches.

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinSpawn
steps.label: a tame Asksvin behind the trail, with the harness state

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinHarnessOn
steps.label: no saddle: the harness is refused and kept

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinHarnessOn
steps.label: saddled: the harness goes on and is used up

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonHitch
steps.label: E on the tow ring hitches

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonTowState
steps.regex: towed True, joint True, model True, .*gap 0\.[0-4]\d m, upright True
steps.label: hitched: joint on, harness model shows, ring on the hook, cannon upright

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonGrab
steps.label: E on the cart while towed

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonAttached
steps.label: a towed cannon cannot be grabbed by hand

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinFollow
steps.label: the Asksvin follows the player 22 m away from the cannon

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonTowState
steps.regex: towed True, joint True, model True, moved (1[0-9]|2[0-9])\.\d m, max speed ([4-9]|1[0-9])\.\d m/s \(asksvin \d+\.\d\), .*upright True
steps.label: towed at least 10 m after the follow started, faster than by hand (4+ m/s), still upright

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonHitch
steps.label: E on the tow ring again unhitches

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonTowState
steps.contains: towed False, joint False, model False
steps.label: unhitched: no joint, harness model hidden
